profile.headline: Web Developer at Neon Canvas
profile.summary:
Web Developer focused on WordPress, Webflow, HubSpot, and marketing systems.

I enjoy solving the messy problems that sit between marketing, design, and technology whether that's building a website, migrating a CMS, integrating a CRM, automating workflows, or tracking the data that helps teams make decisions.

I've delivered 25+ websites across WordPress and Webflow and regularly work with HubSpot, GA4, GTM, and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate research, troubleshooting, and implementation.

positions.title: Senior Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
Duties:
Facilitated the transfer and sales of securities.
Assembled up-to-date information on dividend schedules, proxy votes and odd-lot programs.
Educated employees on details of ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Plan) and Stock Options from different companies such as Home Depot and Leidos.
Resolved issues for shareholders.

Key Accomplishments:
Succeeded transition from temporary employee to company employee in under 1 year.
Consistent recognition for efficiency and quality assurance scores.
